# Test data

Sample log lines for the parser and tailer unit tests. These files are
for tests only; runtime code never imports them.

All IP addresses are anonymised to documentation ranges (RFC 5737):
`203.0.113.0/24` (TEST-NET-3), `198.51.100.0/24` (TEST-NET-2) and
`2001:db8::/32` (documentation IPv6). Hostnames are generic, and the
SSH key fingerprint is a placeholder of `A` characters. No real log
data, real addresses, or real credentials appear here.
